name: 3webs OBS
description: Observes how a domain appears across the three webs — the human web, the AI web and the machine web — and returns evidence-based findings. One-shot or permanent observation.

skills.name: Observe a domain once
skills.description: Fetch a domain's public resources and evaluate 167 signals across the human web, the AI web and the machine web. Returns a full report synchronously: global score, per-dimension scores, per-signal verdict with the evidence found, and a prioritised action plan. Deterministic — the same domain in the same state returns the same result.
examples: What do AI systems see on example.com?
Run a one-shot observation of example.com across all three webs
Audit example.com and tell me which signals fail

skills.name: Observe a domain permanently
skills.description: Register a domain for scheduled re-observation. Runs on a Cloudflare Cron Trigger at the chosen interval (daily, weekly or monthly), records each score, and POSTs a change notification to a callback URL when the score moves past your threshold. Email delivery is not yet wired to a provider — use a callback URL.
examples: Watch example.com weekly and tell me if anything breaks
Monitor example.com and notify me when the score drops by 5 points

skills.name: Compare two observations
skills.description: Return the deterministic delta between a baseline observation and the current state of the same domain: which signals changed, in which direction, and the evidence for each change.
examples: Did my changes to example.com work?
Show me the delta since the last observation

skills.name: Explain a single signal
skills.description: Return the evidence behind one signal verdict — what was fetched, what was found in it, and why the rule produced that result. Use this before acting on a failure.
examples: Why did llms.txt fail on example.com?
Explain the GEO entity graph signal for example.com
What evidence did you find for the robots.txt AI crawler signal?

skills.name: List the signal catalogue
skills.description: Return the full catalogue of 167 signals grouped by dimension (AI Signals, AEO, GEO, AIO, SEO) and by web (human, AI, machine), including the weight of each signal.
examples: Which signals belong to the machine web?

x-3webs.determinism: Scores are produced by fixed rules on observed evidence. No score is generated by a language model.
x-3webs.honest_gaps: Signals that cannot be verified are returned as not_applicable, never as failures.
